body.x: Forest Walk, pitched to the age of the students and the size of the batch.

Delhi is one of the greenest capital cities in the world and the air in it is filthy. Both are true at once, and a forest walk is where students feel that contradiction instead of reading about it. Sanjay Van, the Asola Bhatti wildlife sanctuary, the Okhla bird sanctuary — city forests, reachable on a school morning, with far more living in them than students expect. Go with somebody who knows the plants and birds by name; a walk with a guide is a different event from a walk. Any city can do this. The nearest ridge, reserve forest, riverbank or old park with real trees in it will do.
